component.name: MainScene
component.script:
sub init() m.task = createObject("roSGNode", "ClearingTask") m.task.observeField("payload", "onPayload") m.task.observeField("finished", "onFinished") m.task.control = "run" end sub
sub onPayload(event as object) node = event.getData() if node = invalid print "PAYLOAD: invalid" else print "PAYLOAD: "; node.id end if end sub
sub onFinished(event as object) print "FINISHED: task completed" m.top.done = true end sub
